assessment.nobel_worthiness: A fundamental, elegant account of phase transitions and defect unbinding in two dimensions, with enduring reach across soft and condensed matter.
assessment.attribution: The credited theorists established the central mechanism and its decisive predictions.
assessment.maturity: The framework is long established and extensively tested in physical two-dimensional systems.
uncertainties: The experimental phenomenology can be affected by finite size, disorder, and system-specific interactions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Exact relations that give nonequilibrium statistical mechanics a remarkably simple and universal organizing principle.
assessment.attribution: The named contributors are strongly associated with the foundational fluctuation and work relations.
assessment.maturity: The results have been broadly confirmed and applied, including in small fluctuating systems.
uncertainties: The proper division of priority among closely related formulations needs careful historical examination.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Photonic band gaps made a deep solid-state concept into a versatile optical design principle with wide scientific consequences.
assessment.attribution: The credited names represent seminal conceptual, experimental, and theoretical contributions.
assessment.maturity: The field is mature, with extensive realization and durable influence on nanophotonics.
uncertainties: Credit for the broader photonic-crystal field extends beyond three individuals.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dynamical mean-field theory supplied a powerful and conceptually clear route to strongly correlated electron matter.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names are central to the formulation and establishment of the method.
assessment.maturity: It is a standard, extensively benchmarked framework with major impact on correlated materials theory.
uncertainties: Its status as a method, rather than a single discovery, may complicate a Nobel framing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric phase and quantum phase effects reveal fundamental structure in quantum mechanics and have shaped many later areas.
assessment.attribution: Both credited figures made distinct, seminal contributions to quantum phase phenomena.
assessment.maturity: The effects are experimentally secure and conceptually integrated across modern physics.
uncertainties: The two effects are related but historically and conceptually distinct, making a single citation delicate.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical-lattice quantum simulation created exceptionally clean, controllable realizations of important many-body models.
assessment.attribution: The selected experimental leaders are closely identified with decisive implementations and observations.
assessment.maturity: The platform is mature and has transformed experimental many-body physics.
uncertainties: The intellectual and technical credit is distributed across an unusually broad theory-experiment community.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atom interferometry has made quantum coherence into a precise instrument for measurements of exceptional fundamental and practical value.
assessment.attribution: The credited names represent key theoretical and experimental advances in the field.
assessment.maturity: The techniques are highly developed and their precision capabilities are convincingly demonstrated.
uncertainties: The field overlaps substantially with other atom-optics and precision-measurement achievements.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks combine a clean physical idea with extraordinary demonstrated precision and broad metrological impact.
assessment.attribution: The two credited researchers are leading originators of the optical-lattice-clock approach and its realization.
assessment.maturity: Performance and reproducibility have reached a mature level across multiple laboratories.
uncertainties: Further confirmation of ultimate applications and a precise boundary from related optical-clock work remain relevant.
